stateContract.initialLoading: render all six regions once with target-shaped skeleton slots
stateContract.refreshingWithData: keep existing data visible; mark header and daily status as updating; do not render a second page skeleton
stateContract.empty: keep all target regions; show unavailable values and disabled content slots
stateContract.errorWithoutData: keep all target regions; place retry in the daily brief action area
stateContract.stale: render fallback data with home-level and item-level local fallback labels; never display official-ready status
stateContract.ready: render only backend-verified article fields and trusted media
